name: Atomic child creation with an assignee and priority
summary: create-child accepts optional assignee and priority fields in its one native create, eliminating separate follow-up updates. The endpoint reuses the raw update's exact assignee resolver and assigned-mode authority guard; bd validates the identical dry-run before any issue or receipt is written. Omitting the fields preserves the legacy request digest, native arguments and result, while changing either on replay is refused.
